svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How the action works
svg.desc: How the action works. 12 components in 1 groups. Connections: Daily cron to setup-python (uses: @v1); setup-python to Read inputs; Read inputs to Fetch stats; GitHub GraphQL API to Fetch stats (POST /graphql); Fetch stats to Compute stats; Compute stats to Render card; Render card to Write SVG; Write SVG to Your commit step (output SVG); Your commit step to Your README (git push); Fetch stats to Keep old card (card exists); Fetch stats to Fail the run (no card yet).

text.tspan: One standard library Python script in a composite action. The token goes to api.github.com and nowhere else.
